切換到其他視窗，還能繼續嗎？: Will it keep running if I switch windows?
可以，前提是目標程式接受背景按鍵訊息。AutoKey 不會切換你的操作焦點；切回: Yes, provided the target app accepts key messages in the background. AutoKey will not change your focus, and switching back does not require another hotkey press to restart it. Refer to the desktop app instructions for how execution stops when the computer locks, sleeps, or the target app closes.

Test with a simple key first. Keeping the window active or using elevated permissions does not guarantee compatibility.

Sequential commands and precisely timed combos are not supported, and combinations of multiple keys are not guaranteed to work.
